purpose: Offline, read-only reconciliation of source-supplied fleet commissioning records for an Atlas private-beta onboarding conversation.
identity: Every device, alias, authority, certificate, event and expectation is scoped by exact organization_id. Never infer aliases from case or punctuation.
asOf: Explicit ISO-8601 timestamp including Z or numeric offset. Only observations at or before this timestamp determine the current reconciled view; future records remain visible.
sourcePolicy: Keep every admitted original UTF-8 CSV byte-for-byte (including BOM, CRLF and empty records), with filename, digest, row locations, explicit mapping and immutable edition. A correction creates a new edition. One selected edition per family drives a view; older editions and their decisions remain available.
semantics: Certificate dates, issuer IDs and fingerprints are metadata checks. The desk does not validate signatures, prove private-key possession, establish trust or determine actual revocation enforcement.
Duplicate primary identities, unknown organizations/references, conflicting latest lifecycle states and overlapping expectations are explicit unresolved findings.
A telemetry record is available as of a time only if both observed_at and received_at are not later than that time. Retain future and impossible clock relationships separately.
Each expectation supplies its own silence limit. Missing/ambiguous expectations do not become a guessed health threshold.
Audit action/outcome remain literal supplied evidence; an action name is not assumed to prove a device state transition.
No requests to Atlas or devices, no issuance/revocation, no control commands, no private-key/credential intake.
workingContract: Retain all source editions, current selection, all exact review decisions and unfinished literal intake forms. Save independent proposed work before switching copies. A conflicting head is recoverable without overwriting the foreign head. Emergency export must work after storage failure.
acceptance: Reopen a complete original and corrected authored example and reproduce the selected source digests and result.
Show same device_id in different organizations separately; duplicate identity within an organization is unresolved.
Show simultaneous contrary state records as a conflict, not a guessed latest winner.
Separate certificate date metadata, missing issuer references and telemetry silence from a security assessment.
Changing source selection or as-of time changes the decision basis; earlier decisions remain in history.
A failed local save still permits a complete emergency download; imported pending forms remain literal.
